<div class="card-body">
'''Imperial Blaster''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Character Weapon]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国軍制式ブラスター</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して、戦士キャラクターに配備する。１フォース消費して起動する。運命数を引く。運命数＞能力値なら、キャラクターに命中する。運命数＞回避値か装甲値ならば、ビークルに命中する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Imperial-Blaster-SWCA-100696.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ブラステックＤＨ－17ブラスター・ピストル。エネルギー・パックと高エネルギー・ブラスター・ガスを使う。起爆性の収束光を発射する。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Imperial Blaster.

'''Card text:'''
Spend 1 Force to deploy on a warrior character. Spend 1 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny exceeds ability. A vehicle is hit if destiny exceeds maneuver or armor.

'''Lore:'''
A BlasTech DH-17 blaster pistol. It uses energy packs and high-energy blaster gas and fires explosive focused light.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese wording describes firing the weapon where the original English says to target.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Blaster]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
